Today we feature the remarkable story of Carrie Sheffield, author of "Motorhome Prophecies." Raised in a chaotic and abusive environment, Carrie shares her journey through trauma, survival, and eventual triumph, finding peace and purpose against the odds.

Listen as Carrie recounts the challenges of her upbringing, her struggle with fibromyalgia, and the healing power of forgiveness and gratitude. From living in a motorhome as part of a cult-like existence to earning a scholarship to Harvard and becoming an esteemed journalist, Carrie's story is one of resilience and self-discovery.
